cohort: 152 pregnant women at a high risk of sPTB recurrence due to a history of sPTB.
finding: Lactobacillus iners dominance in the vaginal microbiota before 16 weeks of gestation is associated with an increased risk of recurrent spontaneous preterm birth, partly due to its propensity to transition to an unfavorable non-Lactobacillus-dominant state.
cross-section timing: Vaginal swabs were collected sequentially during early pregnancy (before 16 weeks) and late pregnancy (16-24 weeks).
gest_age: Risk for sPTB recurrence between 16 and 27+6 weeks of gestation.
